issue.title: Add a shout() helper
issue.body:
Add `shout(name)` to `greet.py`: it returns the greeting from `greet(name)` in upper case, ending in `!` instead of `.`.

## Acceptance criteria
1. `greet.shout("Ada")` returns `"HELLO, ADA!"`.
2. `greet()` is unchanged.
3. A unit test in `test_greet.py` covers `shout()`.
